title: My AI agents work while I'm on holiday
hook: I needed a remote system to help me with my video editing.
summary:
How I run my AI agents from anywhere with Hermes + Telegram.
Going on holiday, I wanted to keep editing videos without my PC. Claude Code on my phone was too finicky, so:
1. An old laptop connects remotely to my PC, so I get all its power and compute
2. Hermes (an AI agent harness) runs my agents on it
3. It's hooked up to Telegram, so I text it a job and it edits my reels, cleans up my Notion board and sends the previews straight back to my phone
Comment TELEGRAM and I'll send you exactly how I set up the bot.
